            if (c == '(') {

                        maxSize = Math.max(maxSize, currentSize);
                        currentSize = 0;

            }
        }

        boolean inside = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];

            if (c == '(') {

                }
            }
        }

        return wordCount;
